title: Insurance claims
goal: Show a policyholder claim journey including fraud escalation.

rubric.must: Claims Management Platform is a visible subject boundary around all claim capabilities.
Lodge Claim has dashed «include» arrows pointing to Validate Policy and Request Documents.
Investigate Fraud extends Lodge Claim toward its suspected fraud extension point.
Validate Policy is associated with the external Policy Administration actor.
Fraud Analyst generalizes to Adjuster using a hollow triangle.
